results.title: US Appeals Court Blocks Trump’s $400 Million White House Ballroom Project Pending Congressional Approval
results.description: A US federal appeals court has blocked above-ground construction of Donald Trump’s proposed $400 million White House ballroom, ruling that major changes to the White House require congressional approval. The decision keeps underground work moving for now and gives the administration 14 days to seek relief from the US Supreme Court.

results.title: US Intel's New Fear: A Cornered Putin Takes a Swing at NATO: REPORT
results.description: New US intelligence assessments say Vladimir Putin could order a limited test of NATO's resolve sometime between this autumn and 2029, a warning reinforced by a suspected Russian drone found armed with explosives at a German airport — though CNN, CBS, and Poland's own spy chief frame the risk and timeline in noticeably more cautious terms than the headline claim suggests.
